labelled_by: Proposed by Claude with an evidence phrase per label; every label reviewed by the developer (one change: R18 WMT|Item 1|2 rel -> border)
relevance_rule: rel: a reader could write at least one sentence answering the question from this chunk alone, for this company. border: on topic but generic, a summary-list fragment, hypothetical, or only partly about the question. Pooled chunks without a label are not relevant. Chunks outside the pool are UNJUDGED, not irrelevant.
pool_method: Retriever top 10 for the original question, unioned with keyword hits (regexes written from the question, before reading retrieved text), keyword pool capped at 25 per question. Broad questions: no keyword pool; the top 10 of every query variant is labelled, for precision only. Round 2 added every chunk that entered a top 10 unjudged.
